title: Notifications
emptyHint: Task updates, reminders, approvals and alerts about your books show up here.
task_assigned_body: You've been asked to do this.
task_commented_body: Open the task to read and reply.
goal_achieved_body: Well done. Time to set the next one.
export_ready_body: Download it from Reports. The link lasts a few days.
ledger_check_failed_body: The nightly check found figures that don't match the ledger.
audit_check_failed_body: The nightly check found the audit log may have been changed.
integration_needs_reauth_body: Syncing has paused until you sign in again.
integration_sync_failing_body: {{failures}} syncs in a row have failed.
auth_password_reset_body: Check your email for the link.
auth_password_changed_body: If this wasn't you, reset it now.
auth_account_locked_title: Your account was locked for 15 minutes
auth_session_reuse_detected_body: We signed a session out. Check your active sessions.
settingsSubtitle: Everything always shows in the app. Choose what else reaches you, and when to keep quiet.
inAppHint: The bell at the top. Always on.
emailHint: A copy of each notification by email.
pushHint: Alerts on your devices, even when the app is closed.
quietHoursHint: No email or push in these hours. They wait until the quiet hours end.
pushSubtitle: Turn push on in each browser where you'd like alerts.
pushNotConfigured: Push notifications aren't set up on this server yet.
pushUnsupported: This browser can't receive push notifications. On iPhone, add the app to your Home Screen first.
pushDenied: This browser is blocking notifications from this site. Allow them in the browser's site settings, then come back.
pushBlocked: Notifications weren't allowed, so push stays off.
pushOn: Push is on for this browser
billing_plan_ending_body: It ends on {{endsOn}}. Choose a plan to keep everything; nothing is ever deleted.
billing_plan_ended_grace_body: It keeps working until {{until}}. Renew before then to keep it.
billing_plan_ended_body: You're on Free now. Nothing was deleted, and you can upgrade any time.
